investigation_notes.Description: The Vitalis Healthcare logo is displayed prominently in a feature article on themedicalbulletin.org and visually matches the brand mark and text. The page is an editorial/news article with no visible credential fields, urgent account lures, or data-collection forms, indicating informational context rather than impersonation. The domain is long-established (12 years) and the site is served via Cloudflare with a benign reputation score; no recent similar alerts were found. Based on the editorial context, accurate visual match, and low infrastructure risk, this alert is assessed as low priority.
